title: Eh
text: Eh. Feel like I got away with something finding these. Nobody sells curtains for 96” doors with glass panels for under $100. They’re not great quality though. As someone else mentioned in their review, the pattern is not repeated on the back for whatever reason, I mean they could’ve at least put a liner. Took photos during the day from the inside and at night from the outside. Pretty good privacy unless someone wants to be a creeper and put their face up to the door. I was honestly surprised I couldn’t see in the house at night with these because they're pretty thin. I didn’t want to have to sew custom curtains so if it weren’t for the double ended pockets and that these are for my back doors where not a lot of people would see them, I don’t think I’d keep these.
